sermon.title: Jesus Invited 12 to Himself 05/26/2019
sermon.series: Why Jesus Is Important to All Mankind
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer looks at the twelve Jesus invited to Himself: not scholars or philosophers but teachable men with flaws. Peter cursed and denied Him, all forsook Him, yet when they repented and Jesus opened their understanding, they never turned back. God still calls and refines ordinary people.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.
